plugins.name: Jira Cloud
plugins.description: Read-only Jira Cloud integration. Lists and views issues via JQL against Atlassian REST v3. The first proving plugin of LiteDuck's plugin system.
plugins.author: bemindlabs

plugins.name: BWOC Orchestration
plugins.description: Optional, read-only integration with the external BWOC agent-orchestration CLI. Detects the binary and lists the registered agent roster. LiteDuck never spawns or modifies agents.
plugins.author: bemindlabs
